ValidationRule.description: LFRDN-684: Close Date was freely editable after Closed Won, letting a deal be back-dated into an earlier accounting period. Locks it once Closed Won, exempting AF_CanBypassStageGates for a genuine, attributable correction.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Close Date cannot be changed after the deal is Closed Won - it records when FR6's completion conditions were satisfied. Requires the "Bypass Stage Gates" permission for a genuine correction.
